parts.text:
Now use all the given information:
1. model.json file
2. operation.json file
3. Multiview images

Decide which sections of the original model should be modified, removed, interacted with or if new sections should be created. Use as much information from the Multiview images, model.json files and operation.json as possible.

Make this decision from several perspectives. If target clearly identify geometry, locate the corresponding section(s) and face(s) in model.json. If there is no clear geometry identified, use the referenced features and relational_constraint to identify potential sections and features. Additionally, consider the intention of the edit. Based on the function and behavior associated with each section and features, decide which section require the action the most. Then, find the corresponding section and face code from model.json.

Plan out the modeling procedure needed to perform each action. Describe them in professional CAD modelling languages from choosing the plane, draw sketches to extrusion, add chamfers. Be thorough and detailed.

face_code values in model.json are visual labels from shaded renders. Brep_id is the CadQuery Faces() index from the STEP analysis report (for example FACE 0).

Edit operation.json accordingly. Keep the previous request_wording and actions, and add localization plus steps.

OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON, operation.json, no markdown fences, use this schema):
{
  "request": "",
  "request_wording": {
    "action_words": ["..."],
    "referenced_feature_words": ["..."],
    "intention_words": ["..."],
    "grammatical_words": ["..."]
  },
  "actions": [
    {
      "operation": "...",
      "parameters": {
        "parameter_name": "..."
      },
      "target": "...",
      "relational_constraint": "...",
      "unresolved_reference": "...",
      "target section code": ["..."],
      "target face code": ["..."],
      "steps": [
        "...",
        "..."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "intention": ["..."]
}

The model.json, operation.json, and labeled multi-view images follow.

{
  "request": "Design cylindrical bearing on the flat end of the part (the one without fillet). Create another 7 instances of this design and rotate them around the bearing axis.",
  "request_wording": {
    "action_words": [
      "Design",
      "cylindrical",
      "Create",
      "another",
      "7",
      "instances",
      "rotate"
    ],
    "referenced_feature_words": [
      "on",
      "flat",
      "end",
      "part",
      "one",
      "without",
      "fillet",
      "this",
      "design",
      "them",
      "around",
      "bearing",
      "axis"
    ],
    "intention_words": [
      "bearing"
    ],
    "grammatical_words": [
      "the",
      "of",
      "the",
      "the",
      "of",
      "and",
      "the"
    ]
  },
  "actions": [
    {
      "operation": "Create a cylindrical bearing feature",
      "parameters": {
        "shape": "cylindrical"
      },
      "target": "The flat end of the existing part",
      "relational_constraint": "Place the bearing on the flat end that is not filleted.",
      "unresolved_reference": "Identify which flat end face of the existing part is the one without a fillet."
    },
    {
      "operation": "Create additional instances of the bearing design",
      "parameters": {
        "additional_instance_count": "7"
      },
      "target": "The cylindrical bearing feature created by the previous action",
      "relational_constraint": "Each new instance must be an instance of the same bearing design.",
      "unresolved_reference": "Resolve the bearing feature created by the previous action as the source feature for instancing."
    },
    {
      "operation": "Rotate the additional bearing instances",
      "parameters": {},
      "target": "The 7 additional bearing instances",
      "relational_constraint": "Rotate the instances around the bearing axis.",
      "unresolved_reference": "Resolve the cylindrical bearing's axis as the rotation axis. The rotation angle and angular distribution are not specified."
    }
  ],
  "intention": [
    "Provide bearing functionality at the non-filleted flat end of the part."
  ]
}
